summary_1line: Rama informs Sita of his fourteen-year exile and instructs her to remain in Ayodhya, serve the royal family, and obey Bharata.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita rises trembling from her seat as she sees Rama enter unadorned, his face pale and sorrowful instead of crowned for coronation.
Inside the richly decorated palace prepared for coronation, Rama stands with bowed head before Sita while announcing his exile to the forest.
